title: The Lone Star State.
old_caption:
Ever felt like the only star in a really big sky?
On the road across Texas, every stop wakes up a new one. No more lone stars.

title: Dear Houston: the Loop.
old_caption:
Been talking for months and still do not know what you are?
Gemini and Sagittarius stop circling. Take the exit and ask.

title: Dear Lubbock: look up.
old_caption:
When was the last time you saw a sky full of stars?
With nothing to hide behind, the stars say: be someone your date can see clearly.

title: The map is lighting up.
old_caption:
The map is lighting up, one city at a time.
Texas is in. Every other city is still in it. Which one should glow next?

title: Near Marfa, there are mystery lights.
old_caption:
Ever dated someone as hard to read as a mystery light?
Near Marfa, Aries skips the guessing and says it plainly: i like you, dinner?

title: Tonight's deck dealt them each other.
old_caption:
What if you saw who they are before you saw their face?
Leo and Aquarius, two fixed signs, get dealt each other. Card first.

title: Dear Miami.
old_caption:
Feel like everyone you meet is just passing through?
Be the one who says what you're looking for. Something real is allowed.

title: Mission Control, we have a profile.
old_caption:
Would you say yes before seeing a single photo?
In Space City the profile card launches first. Face last, person first.

title: Meanwhile, in Montrose…
old_caption:
Painted a mural of your crush while swearing you do not do crushes?
Aquarius and Leo keep catching each other looking in Montrose.

title: The Moon has notes for Houston.
old_caption:
Planned the perfect first date? Here's the second one.
Plan the first for their Sun, the next for their Moon. Ask what they need.
